checks: Read aadf3a80572ef300:04 §§4–5, (7). The proof checks the same three integer fibers, smoothed actual objective and fixed marginals. The product census and centroid are immediate from the stated triangle.

Positive-definite covariance makes the normalized continuous covectors a compact ellipse. A centered inball gives a uniform nontrivial projection strip at small h and positivity of the own minimum. On an extreme base, a finite tilt excludes the other two ramps.

The centered cyclic permutation preserves the triangle and covariance norm. The orbit of any nonzero covector spans the plane and sums to zero. A positive projection on each nonzero mark displacement allows reuse of a minimizing covector with a strictly smaller own term, because its original transition strip has positive area.

At middle zero at least one endpoint has nonnegative base shift and pays at least the own term. Pure-base caps pay at least twice the fiber area. Large tilts saturate the endpoint terms uniformly, so the actual middle infimum is attained with an oblique covector. Its cyclic orbit gives strict own decrease and no endpoint increase at each other middle mark.

Vertical sections give the first-coordinate density (2/9)(2−t) on [−1,2]. For any coupling the positive-part lower bound on squared midpoint norm integrates exactly to 1/216. Independently checked the rational integral.
Physical Jensen holds because the equally weighted two lifted marginals themselves have mean (0,0). It does not require a deterministic midpoint law.

overlap.comparison: A four-fiber planar triangle product with positive invariant inner buffer has related cyclic direction symmetry and a unique actual deepest mark. Its lattice census and smoothed problem differ from the present three-fiber, zero-inner-buffer example, and it gives no fixed-endpoint cost obstruction.

readability: The uniqueness comparison is over the actual sampled three-fiber mixed set, as in the source. Adding “among actual sampled marks” would make this implicit domain explicit.

summary: For all small positive widths the triangle product has one actual sampled deepest mark, and the full uniform endpoint laws have a positive squared-midpoint defect there despite physical Jensen.
